title: 第三回 惊人跃变第四回 鼠妖掳掠
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: 第三回惊人跃变
【第二天】
顾长世对贺氏言：“老伴，这孩子不会是个仙种吧？”
“抱回来才一天，他就能站会走了。”
“这……不合常理啊。”
贺氏笑：“想得美，要是个仙种，神仙不会自个儿留着？”
天坑洞内，小妖匆匆禀报：“大王，我们去探了，那家人得了一个孩子，来历不明。”
巨齿鼠：“哦？！”
“那对老夫妇年岁已高，还能得子，真是怪事！”
“难道说，跟那天的凶兆有关？”
【第三天】
顾长世对贺氏言：“老伴，鹤雁跟我学劈柴呐。”
贺氏嗔怪："
真是不长心，你别让孩子再砍了自己！
顾长世笑：“放心，我盯着呢。
你是看不见，他劈得可利索了，已经劈开两根啦。”
贺氏：“别让他劈了，来，让他试试我给他做的新衣服。”
“哎呀，怎么盖不住肚皮啊？”
“奇怪，我明明量的好好的呀！”
天坑洞内，小妖再次禀报：“大王，那孩子不得了，长得飞快，一天一个样！”
“不像是个凡种！”
巨齿鼠：“哦，是嘛，接着再探！”
“莫要让他们知道。”
【第四天】
贺氏对顾长世言：“老伴，这孩子真是神了，他刚才竟跟我说，他要听我讲故事！”
“可把我吓了一跳！”
“他啥时学会说话的？”
顾长世闻听哈哈大笑：“哈哈，我就说嘛，这孩子不是普通人。”
“你瞧瞧他这两天的变化！”
“看着惊人呢。”
“你要不试试教他识几个字？”
贺氏闻听点头，招手道：“小鹤雁，来，奶奶教你学写名字。”
天坑洞内，小妖慌慌张张禀报：“大王，不得了了啊。”
“不光那孩子长得快，那孩子的猫长的也快，我们都不敢靠近啦，跟个豹子是的。”
巨齿鼠闻听，眼中却是闪过一丝贪婪：“哦，果然？”
小妖：“那还能假！”
“大王若是不信，可以亲自前去看。”
content_en:
The third surprising change
【The next day】
Gu Changshi said to He: "Honey, isn't this child a fairy?"
"It's only been a day since I brought him back, and he can stand up and walk."
"This...is unreasonable."
He smiled: "What a beautiful thought. If it's an immortal, wouldn't the immortal keep it to himself?"
In the Tiankeng Cave, the little demon hurriedly reported: "Your Majesty, we went to investigate. That family has a child whose origin is unknown."
Megalodon: "Oh?!"
"It's really strange that the old couple can still have a child despite their advanced age!"
"Could it be that it has something to do with the bad omen that day?"
【Day 3】
Gu Changshi said to He: "Honey, He Yan wants to learn to chop firewood with me."
He's angry: "
You're so careless, don't let your child chop yourself again!
Gu Changshi smiled: "Don't worry, I'm watching.
You can't see it, but he split it very neatly, and he has already split two of them. "
He: "Don't let him chop it. Come on, let him try the new clothes I made for him. "
“Oh, why can’t you cover your belly? "
"It's strange, I obviously measured it well! "
In the Tiankeng Cave, the little demon reported again: "Your Majesty, that child is incredible, he is growing up so fast, he looks different every day! "
"It doesn't look like a mortal! "
Megalodon: "Oh, that's right, let's explore again! "
“Don’t let them know. "
【Day 4】
He said to Gu Changshi: "Honey, this kid is really amazing. He just told me that he wanted to listen to my story! "
"It shocked me! "
"When did he learn to speak? "
Gu Changshi laughed loudly after hearing this: "Haha, let me just say, this child is not an ordinary person. "
"Look at the changes in him in the past two days! "
"It looks amazing. "
"Why don't you try to teach him a few words? "
Mr. He nodded and waved: "Little Heyan, come here, grandma will teach you how to write your name. "
Inside the Tiankeng Cave, the little demon panicked and reported: "Your Majesty, this is terrible. "
"Not only does the child grow up fast, but the child's cat also grows fast. We don't dare to get close to him, just like a leopard. "
The giant-toothed rat heard this, but a trace of greed flashed in his eyes: "Oh, as expected? "
Xiaoyao: "That can still be fake! "
“If your Majesty doesn’t believe it, you can go and see it for yourself. "
